extraction: Verified SHA-256 against Homebrew bottle metadata before extracting into a fresh temporary directory with Python tarfile data filter. No installed package was replaced.

recovered_failures.reason: --force-bottle and --bottle-tag are mutually exclusive; retried using the available arm64_golden_gate tag.
Homebrew reported Invalid bottle tag symbol. Located and hash-verified the fetched archive in the download cache instead.

dyld Symbol not found: _BC. Extracted bottle still referenced @@HOMEBREW_PREFIX@@ dylib paths; relocated only its temporary binary with install_name_tool and ad hoc codesigning. Preflight then exited 0.

measurement_protocol: Benchmarks execute sequentially under caffeinate -i. Four Vim workload sessions of 30 samples each in bottle/native/native/bottle order, followed by pairwise comparison. Default warmups/repetitions used for ripgrep, Ctags, and Git. Default 5 iterations used for Speedometer. Battery scripts use normal mode and their full defaults when hardware state permits.
